component.name: NØVA Flash Studio
component.summary: Author ActionScript 3 animations and export SWF films

description.p: NØVA Flash Studio is a native desktop editor for a small, documented ActionScript 3 subset and a Flash-style timeline. It exports real binary SWF files and can open an export in the system default application or in a user-configured Flash Player Projector.
NØVA is not Adobe Flash and does not include a Flash runtime. External playback requires a compatible projector or emulator installed by the user.
